requete_sql: SELECT round(sum(ss_ext_sales_price), 2) FROM store_sales_all JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk=d_date_sk WHERE d_year=2004
SELECT round(sum(ws_ext_sales_price), 2) FROM web_sales_all JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk=d_date_sk WHERE d_year=2004
SELECT count(DISTINCT ss_ticket_number) FROM store_sales_all JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk=d_date_sk WHERE d_year=2004
SELECT count(DISTINCT ws_order_number) FROM web_sales_all JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk=d_date_sk WHERE d_year=2004
SELECT round(sum(ss_ext_sales_price) / count(DISTINCT ss_ticket_number), 2) FROM store_sales_all JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk=d_date_sk WHERE d_year=2004
SELECT round(sum(ws_ext_sales_price) / count(DISTINCT ws_order_number), 2) FROM web_sales_all JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk=d_date_sk WHERE d_year=2004
SELECT sum(ss_quantity) FROM store_sales_all JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk=d_date_sk WHERE d_year=2004

kpi: Taux de remise magasin 2004 en % (ext_discount_amt / ext_list_price)
requete_sql: SELECT round(100 * sum(ss_ext_discount_amt) / sum(ss_ext_list_price), 2) FROM store_sales_all JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk=d_date_sk WHERE d_year=2004

kpi: Taux de coupon magasin 2004 en % (coupon_amt / ext_sales_price)
requete_sql: SELECT round(100 * sum(ss_coupon_amt) / sum(ss_ext_sales_price), 2) FROM store_sales_all JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk=d_date_sk WHERE d_year=2004
SELECT round(100 * (sum(ss_ext_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE d_year=2004) / sum(ss_ext_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE d_year=2003) - 1), 2) FROM store_sales_all JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk=d_date_sk

kpi: Part du web dans le CA (magasin+web) 2004 en %
requete_sql: SELECT round(100 * w / (w + s), 2) FROM (SELECT (SELECT sum(ws_ext_sales_price) FROM web_sales_all JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk=d_date_sk WHERE d_year=2004) w, (SELECT sum(ss_ext_sales_price) FROM store_sales_all JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk=d_date_sk WHERE d_year=2004) s)

kpi: Montant des retours magasin 2004 (sr_return_amt, date de retour)
requete_sql: SELECT round(sum(sr_return_amt), 2) FROM store_returns_all JOIN date_dim ON sr_returned_date_sk=d_date_sk WHERE d_year=2004

kpi: Taux de retour en quantité, ventes magasin 2004 (cohorte de vente)
requete_sql: SELECT round(100 * sum(sr_return_quantity) / (SELECT sum(ss_quantity) FROM store_sales_all JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk=d_date_sk WHERE d_year=2004), 2) FROM store_returns_all r JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ss_ticket_number, ss_item_sk, ss_sold_date_sk FROM store_sales_all) s ON s.ss_ticket_number=r.sr_ticket_number AND s.ss_item_sk=r.sr_item_sk JOIN date_dim ON s.ss_sold_date_sk=d_date_sk WHERE d_year=2004
SELECT round(avg(inv_quantity_on_hand), 1) FROM inventory_all JOIN date_dim ON inv_date_sk=d_date_sk WHERE d_year=2004
SELECT round(sum(ss_net_profit), 2) FROM store_sales_all JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk=d_date_sk WHERE d_year=2004

kpi: Taux de marge nette magasin 2004 en % (net_profit / net_paid)
requete_sql: SELECT round(100 * sum(ss_net_profit) / sum(ss_net_paid), 2) FROM store_sales_all JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk=d_date_sk WHERE d_year=2004

kpi: Nb de lignes de vente magasin 2004 (≠ nb de transactions)
requete_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM store_sales_all JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk=d_date_sk WHERE d_year=2004

kpi: Taux de rupture 2004 en % (relevés stock = 0 / relevés renseignés)
requete_sql: SELECT round(100 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE inv_quantity_on_hand = 0) / count(inv_quantity_on_hand), 3) FROM inventory_all JOIN date_dim ON inv_date_sk=d_date_sk WHERE d_year=2004
SELECT round(avg(pr_review_rating), 2) FROM product_reviews_all WHERE year(pr_review_date)=2004

kpi: Part des clics web liés à une vente 2004 en % (≠ taux de conversion par session)
requete_sql: SELECT round(100 * count(wcs_sales_sk) / count(*), 2) FROM web_clickstreams_all JOIN date_dim ON wcs_click_date_sk=d_date_sk WHERE d_year=2004

kpi: Écart prix courant vs prix concurrent en % (ratio des moyennes / médiane des écarts relatifs)
requete_sql: SELECT round(100 * (avg(i_current_price) / avg(imp_competitor_price) - 1), 2) || ' / ' || round(100 * median(i_current_price / imp_competitor_price - 1), 2) FROM item JOIN item_marketprices ON imp_item_sk=i_item_sk WHERE imp_competitor_price > 0
